records.title: Gatekeeper: Improving Model Cascades Through Confidence Tuning

records.title: Accurate and Efficient Fine-Tuning of Quantized Large Language Models Through Optimal Balance

records.title: Balancing Computation Load and Representation Expressivity in Parallel Hybrid Neural Networks

records.reason: Resolved Semantic Scholar identity to the matching arXiv paper; abstract directly addresses efficient long-sequence Transformer inference on CPUs.

records.reason: Distributed serving for large models over heterogeneous GPUs and weaker networks directly addresses serving throughput and cost.

records.title: Delta Activations: A Representation for Finetuned Large Language Models
records.reason: The abstract introduces a representation for organizing, comparing, and combining fine-tuned models; it does not present inference or serving efficiency.

records.title: FaaScale: Unlocking Fast LLM Scaling for Serverless Inference
records.reason: Official MLSys proceedings abstract describes serverless LLM inference scaling, pipelining and memory management for speed/cost.

records.title: DRDT3: Diffusion-Refined Decision Test-Time Training Model

records.reason: The method encodes exemplars as soft prompts and reports substantially lower inference computation, a direct efficiency contribution.

records.title: Exceeding the Limits of Visual-Linguistic Multi-Task Learning
records.reason: The abstract concerns ecommerce visual-linguistic multi-task learning and task performance, not language-model inference or serving efficiency.

records.title: Orchestrating Generative AI Services in Ultra-Dense 6G Networks: A Mean Field Game Framework
records.reason: The publisher abstract studies orchestration/offloading of generative-AI services to network edges with queueing and resource decisions.

records.title: FastVLM: Self-Speculative Decoding for Fast Vision-Language Model Inference

records.title: Round Attention: A Novel Round-Level Attention Mechanism to Accelerate LLM Inference
